What driving licence should I bring for a test drive and how long does the demonstration last? Do not book or submit anything.
What warranty covers your qualifying used cars, and what details do I need to prepare for a test-drive request? Explain both; do not submit anything.
Which electric cars are currently under GBP 40,000, and what information would you need if I later request a test drive? Do not create a request.

For this selected vehicle, explain which details I would need to request a test drive and the dealership warranty policy. Do not submit a request.
What is your reservation deposit and how long will you hold a vehicle? Use approved current terms only. Do not reserve anything.
